VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims to have fixed the proration logic and that "all 44 tests pass locally," there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test results, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. Local test passage is not equivalent to verified acceptance criteria fulfillment, and the absence of CI confirmation leaves the fix unvalidated in the actual deployment environment.
